cards.ex: Her first novel is considered a seminal work in feminist literature.
cards.exUz: Uning birinchi romani feminist adabiyotida muhim asar hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Adabiyotda juda muhim va ta'sirchan asar, boshqa ishlar uchun asos bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The teacher read aloud a chapter from 'The Hobbit' to the class.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi sinfga 'Xobbit'dan bir bobni baland ovozda o'qib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Matnni eshittirish uchun baland ovozda o'qish.

cards.ex: The judge was looking for literary merit when selecting the winner of the prize.
cards.exUz: Hakam mukofot g'olibini tanlashda adabiy qiymatga e'tibor qaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Asarning adabiy jihatdan qanchalik yaxshi ekanligi, sifati.

cards.ex: I'm going to attend the book launch for the new thriller next week.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta yangi trillerning kitob taqdimotida qatnashmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi kitobning rasmiy taqdimoti, odamlarga tanishtirish tadbiri.

cards.ex: The documentary aims to uncover the untold story of the war.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film urushning aytib berilmagan hikoyasini ochishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hali aytib berilmagan, yashirilgan voqea.

cards.ex: The novel has been in print for over fifty years.
cards.exUz: Roman ellik yildan ortiq vaqt davomida bosmada.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki jurnalning nashr etilgan va sotuvda mavjudligi.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, that edition is now out of print.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, bu nashr endi bosmadan chiqqan.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki jurnalning endi nashr etilmasligi.

cards.ex: Irony is a common literary device used in satire.
cards.exUz: Ironiya satirada ishlatiladigan umumiy adabiy uslubdir.
cards.uzDef: Yozuvchi tomonidan matnni chiroyli qilish uchun ishlatiladigan usul.

cards.ex: I heard they're going to turn that book into a movie.
cards.exUz: Eshitishimcha, ular bu kitobni kino qilib ishlashmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki hikoyani filmga aylantirish.

cards.ex: Don't read too much into his comments; he was just being sarcastic.
cards.exUz: Uning izohlaridan ortiqcha ma'no qidirmang, u shunchaki kinoya qilayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Gap yoki matnda aslida bo'lmagan ma'noni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Shakespeare is a central figure in the Western canon of literature.
cards.exUz: Shekspir G'arb adabiyot kanonida markaziy shaxs hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir davrning yoki madaniyatning eng muhim adabiy asarlari ro'yxati.

cards.ex: She bought a beautiful coffee table book about Italian architecture.
cards.exUz: U italyan arxitekturasi haqida chiroyli dizayn kitobini sotib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta, chiroyli rasmlari bor kitob, stol ustida bezak uchun qo'yiladigan.

cards.ex: He enjoys reading classic literature, especially 19th-century novels.
cards.exUz: U klassik adabiyotni, ayniqsa 19-asr romanlarini o'qishdan zavqlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida mashhur bo'lib kelgan va muhim deb hisoblangan adabiyot.

cards.ex: The artist drew inspiration from nature for her paintings.
cards.exUz: Rassom o'z rasmlari uchun tabiatdan ilhom oldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir ilhomlanib, g'oyalar olish.

cards.ex: Her essay offered a fresh perspective on literary criticism.
cards.exUz: Uning inshosi adabiy tanqidga yangi nuqtai nazarni taqdim etdi.
cards.uzDef: Adabiy asarlarni tahlil qilish va baholash.

cards.ex: The movie had a major plot twist at the end that no one saw coming.
cards.exUz: Filmining oxirida hech kim kutmagan katta syujet burilishi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyaning kutilmagan o'zgarishi, voqealar rivojining kutilmagan yo'nalishi.

cards.ex: The author does a great job of setting the scene in the first chapter.
cards.exUz: Muallif birinchi bobda muhit yaratishda ajoyib ish qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hikoyada voqea sodir bo'ladigan joy va vaqtni tasvirlab berish.

cards.ex: She published a collection of short stories last year.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan yili qissalar to'plamini nashr ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik hajmda bo'lgan adabiy asar.

cards.ex: The story came alive when I saw it on the printed page.
cards.exUz: Men hikoyani bosma sahifada ko'rganimda, u jonlandi.
cards.uzDef: Kitob, gazeta yoki jurnaldagi bosilgan matn.

cards.ex: Tolkien is considered a literary giant of the 20th century.
cards.exUz: Tolkin 20-asrning adabiyot dahosi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Adabiyot sohasida juda mashhur va ta'sirli shaxs.

cards.ex: The screenplay was adapted from a popular novel.
cards.exUz: Ssenariy mashhur romandan moslashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki hikoyani boshqa shaklga (masalan, filmga) o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: I enjoy reading historical fiction because I learn about the past.
cards.exUz: Men tarixiy badiiy adabiyotni o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki men o'tmish haqida bilib olaman.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqealarga asoslangan badiiy asar.

cards.ex: He self-published his first novel on Amazon.
cards.exUz: U o'zining birinchi romanini Amazon'da o'zi nashr ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Muallif tomonidan o'zi nashr qilingan kitob.

cards.ex: She bought an anthology of poems from different eras.
cards.exUz: U turli davrlarga oid she'rlar to'plamini sotib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Turli mualliflarning she'rlaridan iborat kitob.

cards.ex: The book is set in Victorian England.
cards.exUz: Kitob Viktoriya Angliyasida bo'lib o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar kitobda ko'rsatilgan joyda bo'lib o'tadi.

cards.ex: The novel offers a compelling narrative about immigration.
cards.exUz: Roman immigratsiya haqida qiziqarli hikoyani taklif etadi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortadigan va o'qishga undaydigan hikoya.

cards.ex: His latest book is quite controversial and has sparked a lot of debate.
cards.exUz: Uning so'nggi kitobi juda bahsli va ko'plab munozaralarga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p munozaralarga sabab bo'ladigan kitob.

cards.ex: A recurring theme in his novels is the loss of innocence.
cards.exUz: Uning romanlarida takrorlanuvchi mavzu - begunohlikning yo'qolishi.
cards.uzDef: Kitobda qayta-qayta uchraydigan mavzu yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: Sherlock Holmes is a famous fictional character.
cards.exUz: Sherlok Xolms mashhur badiiy obrazdir.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki filmda yaratilgan xayoliy qahramon.

cards.ex: She prefers reading non-fiction to fiction.
cards.exUz: U badiiy adabiyotdan ko'ra hujjatli adabiyotni o'qishni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqiy voqealarga asoslangan adabiyot.
